title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计
abstract: ABSTRACT Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。

title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
title_zh: 不确定性的代价：中美关税对农产品市场的影响
abstract: ABSTRACT We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型的分析结果显示，预期关税公告显著提升了隐含波动率（IV），尤其在2018-2019年贸易战期间表现最为突出。研究表明，玉米和大豆市场对两国发布的公告均产生反应，其中在90%和95%执行价水平上观测到最强的波动效应。进一步分析表明，隐含波动率上升导致生产者的对冲成本增加，进而压缩农场利润空间——当隐含波动率上升7.5%时，大豆期权溢价相应增加约3.75%。这些发现揭示了贸易政策不确定性对商品价格影响之外，对市场参与者造成的额外财务负担。

title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
title_zh: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来
authors: Pierre Azoulay, Raffaella Sadun, Daniela Scur
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.
